name: lib-notify
description: Reusable building block: format a message with a level icon and, if a channel is given, send it with openclaw message send. Always returns the text.

level.description: info, success, warning or alert: picks the icon

notify_channel.description: OpenClaw channel (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...). Empty = don't send, just return the text.

notify_target.description: Chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'const icons = { info: "ℹ️", success: "✅", warning: "⚠️", alert: "🚨" }; const icon = icons[process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_LEVEL] || icons.info; const body = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_BODY.trim(); console.log(icon + " " + process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_TITLE + (body ? "\n" + body : ""))'

MSG=$(cat); if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
